decisions.diagnosis: Southbound channel logged the northbound bikes as well as its own, so its counts are about southbound plus northbound.
decisions.evidence: S >= N in every slot (0-2 exceptions a day vs ~20 normally); S/N 2.2 daily (e.g. 02-17 N 263 S 573) against about 1.0 before and after; S hourly profile = normal S + normal N (hour 16: 16.8 vs 5.4+10.3); ended abruptly 03-01; Como/Cook ratio unchanged for N.

decisions.diagnosis: Same fault as Feb 2013: southbound includes the northbound bikes, just before the counter failed in March 2012.
decisions.evidence: 02-24 S 128 vs N 39 with S<N in 1 slot; 02-26 S 301 vs N 101 with S<N in 0 slots (normally ~20 a day); 02-25 S 294 vs N 171; week S/N 1.88 vs ~1.1 before.

decisions.diagnosis: Southbound somewhat high just before the southbound-includes-northbound fault started, so it may already have begun intermittently.
decisions.evidence: S/N 1.56 and 1.54 (N 96/92, S 150/142); S<N in 11 and 16 slots vs ~20 normally.

decisions.diagnosis: Counts fell to about a fifth of normal for six weeks and then recovered abruptly. This could be the sensor missing hits (TfNSW site comment: MetroCount flagged missing hits 16/07/21-13/08/21), or it could be real lockdown restrictions on riders crossing the Georges River LGA boundary.
decisions.evidence: Como/Captain Cook Br ratio ~1.0-1.5 until 08-05, 0.12-0.46 from 08-06 to 09-19, then 1.1-1.8 from 09-20; weekly N+S 155-332 vs 1164-1540 on either side; both directions fell together and speeds were unchanged; Cook stayed at 500-1270 a week.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage set the zeros missing on the East Coast Low storm days, but riding really was near zero.
decisions.evidence: Captain Cook Br 7 and 0 bikes; Como raw 13 and 4 with counts in the unfixed slots.

decisions.diagnosis: Southbound zeros set missing on a very wet day when riding really was near zero.
decisions.evidence: Captain Cook Br 6 then 34; Como N 5 then 32 with no fix; S raw 4 then 30.

decisions.diagnosis: Northbound zeros set missing on a very wet day, and southbound (unfixed) confirms that almost no one rode.
decisions.evidence: 06-04 Captain Cook Br 4, Como S 4 (unfixed), N raw 5 with 65 slots set missing.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros set missing during the Feb 2020 Sydney deluge, when riding really stopped.
decisions.evidence: Captain Cook Br 15 and 1 bikes; Como raw 24 and 3.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros set missing during the early-July 2022 flood rains, when counts were tiny but real.
decisions.evidence: Como 13, 6 and 4 a day, and the unfixed days after were also tiny (07-04 6, 07-05 15, 07-06 16); counter alive in both directions each day.

decisions.diagnosis: Northbound morning zeros set missing on a very wet day.
decisions.evidence: Captain Cook Br 8 bikes all day; Como S 8 (unfixed), N 4.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros set missing during heavy rain; the counter stayed alive (02 July shows single bikes) and the neighbour was near zero.
decisions.evidence: Captain Cook Br 123, 7 and 12; Como 80, 0 and 6 (Como runs ~0.6x Cook).

decisions.diagnosis: Afternoon and overnight zeros set missing on wet days when riding really was very low.
decisions.evidence: Captain Cook Br 30 and 19 (Cook afternoon hours 0-2 an hour); Como 27 and 8, and the unfixed days after at 7-16.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros set missing on wet days when riding really was very low.
decisions.evidence: Captain Cook Br 12 and 35; Como 7 and 25, with counts resuming normally in the same afternoons.

summary: Site 109 has one MetroCount piezo (counter 101, N/S) running from 2011 to 2026, with automatically handled outages (Mar-Aug 2012, and several in 2014-2025). The main fault is Feb 15-28 2013 (and briefly late Feb 2012), when southbound counts included the northbound bikes; the southbound data there is set missing. The Aug-Sep 2021 collapse matches MetroCount's missing-hits note but could also be lockdown, so it is flagged uncertain; several storm days that zero_outage blanked are restored.
